categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the renewable energy sector focusing on the production and sale of biodiesel and bio-based materials. Its main product lines include biodiesel, bio-ester plasticizers, industrial glycerin, and environmentally friendly alkyd resins. The company also engages in research and development of biofuels and bio-based chemical products, with a strategic focus on integrating biomass energy and bio-based materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced esterification and transesterification technologies to produce high-quality biodiesel from waste oils and fats, achieving a 99% transesterification rate and over 90% yield of high-quality biodiesel. It has developed proprietary impurity detection and removal technologies for waste oils, as well as hydrogenation processes for producing hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO) and sustainable aviation fuels (SAF). The company also integrates digital and intelligent manufacturing technologies to enhance production efficiency and environmental safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international buyers in the renewable energy, chemical, and materials sectors. The company mainly serves the European market through its Dutch subsidiary, with significant exports of biodiesel and bio-based materials. Domestic sales focus on bio-based materials for environmentally friendly plasticizers, coatings, and other industrial applications. The company also targets emerging markets in Southeast Asia and the Middle East for biofuel applications in shipping and aviation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Longyan and Xiamen. It has established subsidiaries and sales platforms in the Netherlands, Singapore, and Thailand to serve European and Southeast Asian markets. The company is expanding its global footprint with ongoing projects in Singapore and Thailand and regional headquarters in Saudi Arabia for Middle East cooperation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the biofuel supply chain. It procures waste oils and fats as raw materials (upstream), processes them into biodiesel and bio-based materials (midstream), and sells finished products directly to end users and distributors (downstream). It has developed a stable and extensive procurement network for waste oils domestically and in Southeast Asia, ensuring raw material supply and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing production technology for waste oil purification, improving biodiesel quality, and developing new bio-based chemical products such as synthetic resins and battery additives. The company invests heavily in R&D to solve challenges related to raw material impurities, process efficiency, and digital transformation of production lines. It actively collaborates with domestic and international research institutions and participates in national standards development for biofuels.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of biodiesel and bio-based chemical products. The company employs a buyout sales model with domestic sales settled mainly on a payment-before-delivery basis and overseas sales often settled via letters of credit. It also benefits from government subsidies and tax incentives related to renewable energy production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer of biodiesel from waste oils, consistently ranking first in China for production volume, export volume, and sales. It holds a strong market position due to its advanced technology, scale, and integrated biomass energy and bio-based materials product chain. It faces competition from other biofuel producers domestically and internationally but maintains competitive advantages in technology and supply chain management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.56 billion, a 26.73% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 149 million, up 89.57%. Total assets reached RMB 3.57 billion, growing 16.3%, with equity of RMB 2.79 billion. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume and revenue, supported by expanding production capacity and international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its ability to produce high-quality, sustainable biodiesel and bio-based materials from waste oils, contributing to carbon reduction and circular economy goals. Its proprietary technologies ensure high raw material conversion rates and product purity, differentiating it from competitors. The integrated product chain from waste oil procurement to advanced bio-based chemical products provides cost advantages and diversified revenue streams. The company also highlights its strong R&D capabilities, international market presence, and compliance with global sustainability certifications.
